title: Shared reference and scalar definitions for the intermediate normalised-record contract
description: CRPS-01 deliverable 11. A record NEVER carries a corpus primary key: the adapter does not write corpus tables (PRD §40.7), so it cannot know one. Cross-record references use natural keys, always implicitly scoped by the envelope's source_id.

natural_key.title: Natural key
natural_key.description: A source-assigned stable key. Explicitly NOT a corpus primary key: the `not` clause rejects the FND-03 opaque-ID form `<prefix>_<uuidv7>` so a generic JSON-Schema validator — not only the Python one — catches the misuse.

node_ref.title: NodeRef
node_ref.description: Identifies one node version by natural key, scoped by the envelope's source_id.

version_ref.title: VersionRef
version_ref.description: Identifies one document version by natural key, scoped by the envelope's source_id.

utc_timestamp.title: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp
utc_timestamp.description: PRD §35.1: timestamps are UTC ISO text. The `Z` suffix is mandatory — a local-time or offset form is rejected.

legal_date.title: Legal date
legal_date.description: PRD §35.1: legal dates are TEXT with YYYY-MM-DD checks. Never a timestamp.

character_offset.title: Character offset
character_offset.description: CRPS-01 deliverable 12: a CHARACTER (Unicode code point) offset into the NFC-normalised canonical_text — not a UTF-8 byte index and not a UTF-16 code unit index. Ranges are half-open [start, end).

json_string.title: Embedded JSON document
json_string.description: A JSON document carried as a string, stored verbatim in the corresponding `*_json` corpus column.
